[SWS_UCM_00161] Check Software Package version compatibility against
UCM
version
⌈
At ProcessSwPackage, TransferData or TransferExit calls, UCM shall raise
ApplicationError IncompatiblePackageVersion
if the version for the
Soft-
ware Package
transferred or to be processed expressed by
minimumSupporte-
dUcmVersion
attribute is higher than the current version of
UCM
⌋

Software Package
is generated by a tooling including a packager which version
could not match with the
UCM
version, leading to manifest interpretation issues for
instance.
